title: First Blog Post
content:
Hi, 
This is my first blog post!

title: Autumn Leaves
content: Today I woke up to a rainy morning! It was beautiful and it reminded me my hometown Ankara! The falling leaves were in the streets. I played Autumn Leaves from Eric Clapton.

title: Last Friday Night!
content:
Yesterday, I hosted a part at my place to celebrate for one of my friend's big milestone. She finished up her Post-Doc at Stanford University! 
I made sangria, mini burgers and a lot of snacks. We did karaoke throughout the night. 
It was fun!
